jobs.description:
The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a Finance Controller who can step in quickly and make an immediate impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.
 

Your role
 

As a Finance Controller, you play a key role in ensuring financial transparency, control, and insight across the organization. This is a plug‑and‑play role: you are operational from day one and work autonomously with limited onboarding.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reporting
 
• Budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
 
• Analysis of costs, margins, and performance
 
• Supporting management with financial insights and decision‑making
 
• Ensuring compliance with internal procedures and external requirements
 
• Preparing audits and improving internal controls
 
• Acting as a sparring partner for operational and technical stakeholders 

Your profile
 

 
• Bachelor or Master degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics
 
• 5+ years experience as Finance Controller or similar role
 
• Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
 
• Excellent Excel skills and experience with ERP systems
 
• Able to work independently and accurately in a complex environment
 
• Hands‑on, proactive, and pragmatic mindset
 
• Comfortable in an international and technical context
 
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English

Our client is a group of specialised companies, together employing around 200 people.
Each company within the group has its own expertise: production of components, welding works, coating, concrete constructions and assembly.

You will join a professional and stable work environment with a highly modern machine park and a strong focus on quality.

Your tasks:
 
• TIG welding of steel and stainless steel constructions 
• Working in a modern workshop with advanced machinery 
• Choice between: 
  
• Pure inhouse-based work 
• inhouse work combined with occasional on-site installation  
• Attractive day shift: 7:30 AM – 4:15 PM (one hour earlier finish on Fridays)
 
• You have completed training as a (TIG/MIG/MAG) welder or can demonstrate relevant experience 
• Motivated junior candidates are welcome 
• You work extremely accurately 
• You are eager to learn and develop yourself 
• You work safely and with attention to detail 
• You can read technical drawings or are willing to learn 
• You speak Dutch or English

In this dynamic role, you will be a key player in our marketing efforts, focusing on both content creation and campaign execution for the Benelux market.

Content & Localization

• 
Translate & Localize: You will deliver high-quality translations from English to Dutch and French for a wide range of marketing materials, including websites, social media, newsletters, and videos, skillfully adapting the content to resonate with the Benelux market.

• 
Ensure Brand Consistency: Act as a brand guardian by meticulously reviewing and proofreading all texts to ensure they are consistent, accurate, and perfectly aligned with our brand voice.

• 
Create Engaging Content: Support the creation of compelling marketing content that highlights the innovation and value of Bosch parts, equipment, and services.

Marketing & Campaign Support

• 
Campaign Execution: Drive the coordination and execution of promotional campaigns, from creating newsletters to preparing materials and managing all follow-up activities.

• 
Digital Channel Management: Keep our digital presence fresh and relevant by updating customer portals, managing website content, and adapting our social media presence for local audiences.

• 
Event & Logistical Support: Contribute to the successful organization of customer events and marketing initiatives, including handling the internal ordering and logistics of point-of-sale materials.

• 
Analysis & Reporting: Help shape our strategy by preparing insightful presentations, conducting market and competitor analysis, and contributing to monthly data updates for new product introductions.

• 
You are currently a student pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, Translation, or Language Studies, with a clear passion for content creation and marketing communications.

• 
You are highly proficient with the MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams). Experience with creative tools like Adobe InDesign or Premiere Pro is a significant advantage.

• 
As a well-organized and detail-oriented multitasker, you thrive in a fast-paced environment and can work independently to meet tight deadlines.

• 
You are an excellent communicator and a collaborative team player who enjoys achieving goals together.

• 
Language Skills:

• 
Dutch: Native or equivalent proficiency (Mandatory)

• 
English: Full professional fluency (Mandatory)

• 
French: A good working knowledge is a strong asset.

NTT Data is looking for an API / SOA Architect

Location: Belgium (Fully Remote Possible)

Contract Type: Freelance or Permanent
About the role

NTT Data is looking for an experienced API / SOA Architect to help design and drive enterprise integration and API strategies within complex and large-scale environments.

As API / SOA Architect, you will define architecture standards, API governance frameworks, security principles, and integration roadmaps that support digital transformation and enterprise interoperability.

We welcome Junior, Medior, and Senior professionals who have experience in API management, integration architecture, cloud-native technologies, and modern service-oriented architectures.

Key responsibilities:

• Define API and SOA architecture strategies and standards

• Design REST, SOAP and MicroServices-based integration solutions

• Define API governance and lifecycle Management Frameworks

• Establish security standards using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT and related protocols

• Lead architecture reviews and technical design workshops

• Collaborate with business, development, DevOps, infrastructure and security teams

• Drive DevSecOps, CI/CD and automation initiatives

• Design scalable and reusable enterprise integration patterns

• Produce architecture documentation, guidelines and recommendations

• Support API platform adoption and continuous improvement

What we are looking for

A strong communicator with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills who can work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. You should have a passion for architecture, integration, automation and continuous improvement.

About NTT Data

NTT Data is a trusted global innovator of IT and business services, helping clients transform through consulting, industry solutions, technology modernization and managed services.

• Higher education degree or equivalent experience

• Junior (>1 year), Medior (>3 years), or Senior (>10 years) experience

• Strong understanding of API Architecture and SOA principles

• Experience with REST and SOAP services

• Knowledge of OpenAPI, Swagger, YAML, OAuth2, OIDC, JWT and Jwk

• Experience with API Management Platforms such as Apigee, Axway, WSO2, Red Hat Fuse or similar

• Strong understanding of Java Enterprise environments

• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns and SOA Design Patterns

• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies

• Experience with testing methodologies, DevOps and CI/CD

• Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP

• Experience with source control and collaboration tools including GIT, Jira and Confluence

• 
Languages

• Professional working proficiency in English (mandatory)

• Professional working proficiency in Dutch and/or French (mandatory)

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders

• Technology environment: Java EE, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Apache CXF, Docker, OpenShift, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Jenkins, Maven, GIT, Snyk, sonarqube, Neo4j, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, OpenAPI and Swagger.
